description:
Activate Tezzeret's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, targeting Worn Powerstone and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Holding priority, activate Worn Powerstone by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Tezzeret's ability, targeting Worn Powerstone and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Resolve the copy of Tezzeret's ability, untapping Worn Powerstone and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Repeat from step 2.
